id.description: stable identifier; stored references use this, never the name (XC-103)

name.description: unique among pipelines of this workspace (XC-103)

onFailure.description: per-case isolation by default; stopping is chosen, never assumed (CT-009)

kind.description: addCases adds to the target set, clear empties it, and the artefact kinds act on all of it (XC-099)

label.description: what the editor shows; not an identifier

caseIds.description: addCases: the explicit cases a drag produced. One unit holds a whole multiple selection

selection.description: addCases: cases resolved when the run starts, through CT-007. Present instead of caseIds, never as well

definitionRef.description: view, graph or report: a pinned workspace item or reusable template; simulation: a pinned saved Simulation workspace item unless a future contract explicitly introduces Simulation templates; never both (XC-109, XC-154)

appliesTo.description: once per case in the target set, or once across the whole set - stated, never inferred

loopOver.description: loop: what fixes the iteration count before the loop starts (XC-100)

variableName.description: one iteration per value of this variable

indexName.description: the name the iteration index is bound to inside

variableName.description: variable and formula: the name bound for the units below

expression.description: formula and condition: this product's restricted expression language, evaluated without a Python interpreter (XC-101)

value.description: variable: a literal value, with its unit stated separately

unitSymbol.description: variable: the declared unit, or absent for undeclared (XC-003)

units.description: contained units, permitted inside loop, condition and simulation, limited to LIM-007 levels

continueOnFailure.description: when true, later units for a failed case still run; the default skips them rather than running on a broken state

runRecord.description: what a run recorded, so it can be reproduced and reviewed

authorisation.description: destructive units are authorised once for the run, naming what they cover

iteration.description: which loop repetition, when inside one

reason.description: for a skipped condition, the value the expression evaluated to

targetSetSize.description: how many cases this unit acted on

definitionRef.description: the exact definition revision resolved for this outcome
